name: magus
description: magus in Claude Code: health of the binary, guard and server; a pane of jobs, runs and agents; prompt-cache expiry and cost warnings

cacheGate.title: Cache expiry gate
cacheGate.description: What happens when you submit after the prompt cache expired: off, warn (a toast), or confirm (holds the prompt once; submit again to send).

cacheWarnMinutes.title: Cache warning window (minutes)
cacheWarnMinutes.description: Show the band above the prompt once this little time is left on the cache.

gateMinTokens.title: Gate threshold (tokens)
gateMinTokens.description: Warn or hold only when the context the next prompt re-sends is at least this large.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto uses what Claude Code reports or what the mod observes, assuming 5m until then.

subagentTokenBudget.title: Subagent token budget
subagentTokenBudget.description: Flag a subagent once its input, output and cache tokens pass this. 0 turns it off.

ratesFile.title: Rates file
ratesFile.description: Absolute path to your own rates JSON (same shape as the mod's rates.json). Empty uses the mod's.

ratesStaleDays.title: Rates age warning (days)
ratesStaleDays.description: Say so when the rates file's checked date is older than this.
